title: A landing that moves
goal: The public landing (/) is too static, not even smooth scrolling: add liveness to it (user, 2026-11-14). Native smooth scrolling; the hero chat plays itself; sections reveal as they are scrolled to; nothing moves for someone who asked their OS to reduce motion.
for_whom: A practising lawyer visiting the public landing before signing up, on a laptop or a phone.

done_check.check: Smooth scrolling: 'See it work on a case', 'Introducing Neethi' and every in-page anchor glide to their section (CSS scroll-behavior: smooth, no scroll library); the wheel and touch scroll as before.

The hero chat keeps playing: three lawyers' questions in turn (an arrest with no reason given, Art. 13(1); custody with no Magistrate, Art. 13(2); a transfer refused for caste, Art. 12(2)), about 11 s each, forever. Each plays in about 4-5 s: the question appears, the trail ticks to 'Read 2 Articles · checked 2 citations', the answer arrives in pieces; only when the answer is done does the cited Article's card rise under the chat (its chip in the answer pulses, then the quoted text lights); then it fades out and the next plays. The card reads as the app: a 'New chat' header with three bars showing which question is playing, a blinking caret in 'Ask a follow-up…', a soft glow behind. Every quoted law is verbatim from the corpus; the card never changes size (all three are in the server HTML, layered).

Scroll reveals: each section's heading and body fade and rise into view the first time they enter the viewport (once, not on every pass); the 'at work' tiles and trust items come in staggered; the case's papers fan out to their angles; the amendment timeline on 'The law as it stands' draws from 1978 to TODAY.
With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the page is exactly today's: everything visible at once, no playing hero, instant anchor jumps.

Nothing breaks: all text is in the server-rendered HTML (readable with JavaScript off and by search engines), no horizontal scroll at 390 px, the page still renders the live coverage counts, and the checks pass.

scenarios.steps: Open / on a laptop, watch the hero, then click 'See it work on a case' and scroll to the end.
scenarios.expect: The question, trail and answer play in, Art. 13(1) lights; the click glides to the Case section; the papers fan out, the tiles stagger in, the timeline draws, pricing and FAQ rise in; nothing replays on scrolling back up.

scenarios.steps: Open / at 390 px wide and scroll through.
scenarios.expect: The same motion, no horizontal scroll, no overlapping papers.

scenarios.steps: Turn on reduce motion (browser emulation) and open /.
scenarios.expect: The page as it was before this change: still and complete.

out_of_scope: The signed-in Home (/dashboard) and other pages (/pricing, /coverage).
Inertial or 'buttery' scroll libraries (Lenis) and any new package: motion is already installed.
Parallax, hover effects, a replay button.
Changing the landing's copy or order, or its design beyond the hero's layout.

decisions.note: Round 1 with the user: the public landing only; hero plays + reveals (not reveals only, not parallax); native smooth scroll (not Lenis); reduced motion = everything still.

After the preview (user): the hero needs recurring animation; chose cycling questions over replaying one exchange or ambient-only. The two new quotes (Art. 12(2), 13(2)) and Art. 126 read from the corpus (kb + R2 text parts) for verbatim text.

After the preview (user): the hero side by side so the animation gets the eye: from lg (1024 px) the words left, the playing chat right, both above the fold at 1440x900; below lg it stays stacked and centred. The arch's dot drawing is hidden side by side (it showed as a stray row of dots).

After the preview (user): the citation panel must come after the answer; and a more appealing hero. The panel left the card's side and became a card rising under the chat at 3.8 s (chip pulse, then mark at 4.3 s); added the chat header with progress bars, caret and glow.

Phone start (user: 'mobile is shit', 'too much content'): below 640 px the hero is the heading (34 px, two lines), one button, then the chat, which now starts about 350 px down at 390x844; the badge, intro paragraph, second button and language line show from sm up. The site header fits one row plus the nav row (it wrapped to three).

Phone, second pass (user: still ugly, congested nav, buttons too large, looks old): the pattern of current product landings: below 640 px the header is the logo, a slim Start free and a menu button (components/public/site-menu.tsx: the links, Sign in and the theme; closes on a pick, Escape or scroll); the hero is a small badge, a 38 px heading, one content-sized button, then the chat card at screenshot scale (13.5 px text, the follow-up line hidden). Questions 2 and 3 reworded shorter so the three are within 21 px of each other in height (248/269/268 px at 390 px; was 248/311/268), so the card has no empty band.

Buttons uniform (user): one size for every public-site button, `btn` in components/public/site.tsx (40 px, 14 px text on a phone; 44 px, 15 px from sm; 8 px corners); cta, ctaQuiet, the Plans buttons and the closing banner's white button are that size in their own colours. Measured at 390 px: every button 40 px / 14 px.

progress.note: Scoped with the user in one round; issue #61; branch app/landing-motion off origin/main, database agent/landing-motion (.env.local points at it, production kept as .env.main).

Built as a preview the user steered over six rounds (decisions), then signed off. How: CSS does the moving (globals.css 'landing motion'), keyed on html[data-motion], which an inline script sets before first paint and components/public/landing-motion.tsx sets on client navigation, both only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; one IntersectionObserver marks [data-reveal] blocks [data-shown] once. The hero is components/public/hero-chat.tsx (client): three exchanges layered in one grid cell (all in the server HTML), the active one gets .hero-play, an 11 s interval moves on. Quotes: Constitution Arts 12, 13, 126 read from the corpus (docWithChunks('constitution'), text from R2) on 2026-11-14; the hero quotes 12(2), 13(1), 13(2) verbatim (12(2), 13(2) cut with an ellipsis). Walked headed on localhost:3000: 1440x900, both columns above the fold, the citation card absent at 2 s and present at 6 s (scratchpad hero-2s.png, hero-6s.png); the three exchanges in turn at 0/12/23 s; scrolled to the end: 24/24 [data-reveal] shown, no horizontal scroll; 390x844: header one row + menu (m8.png), the hero (m7.png), every button 40 px/14 px, no horizontal scroll. d4: agent-browser's reduced-motion emulation did not take (matchMedia stayed false), so checked in two halves: with data-motion removed, 0 hidden blocks, 0 animations, scroll-behavior auto; and the only two starters (MOTION_FLAG/LandingMotion, HeroChat's interval) return early unless no-preference. NOT checked: a real device, Safari, the light theme's look, JS off (the CSS needs data-motion, which only JS sets, so everything shows).

Validation round 1 on 1371ade: semantic PASS (quotes verbatim, smooth scroll, reveal-once, 390 px; d4 by code, emulation does not take), security PASS (no critical/high; inline script a constant; preview guard still asks). Merged PR #62 (rebase, 1926f56); database branch agent/landing-motion deleted; .env.local back to production.
